nodes.name: RAG - Agentic Query
nodes.notes:
LangGraph Agentic RAG Pipeline:

1. Query Analysis
   - Route decision (search vs direct answer)
   - Complex query decomposition (1-3 sub-queries)

2. Hybrid Search
   - BM25 keyword search (top-20)
   - Vector similarity search (top-20)
   - RRF (Reciprocal Rank Fusion)
   - Cross-Encoder Reranker (ms-marco-MiniLM-L-6-v2)

3. Answer Generation
   - Context-aware LLM generation

4. Reflection Loop
   - Self-evaluation (relevance & faithfulness)
   - Query rewriting if failed
   - Re-retrieval (max 2 iterations)

nodes.name: RAGAS - Quality Evaluation
nodes.notes:
RAGAS Metrics:
- Faithfulness (답변이 컨텍스트에 충실한가)
- Answer Relevance (답변이 질문과 관련있는가)
- Context Precision (검색된 컨텍스트의 정밀도)
- Context Recall (ground truth 커버리지)

Note: If answer/contexts not provided,
automatically fetches from RAG service
